definitions.explanation: Being involved with or connected to a person, group or matter, including the dealings people have with each other. The noun of {関|かか}わる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{関|かか}わり。
⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{関|かか}わり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧。
examples.english: To value one's ties with people in the community.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧{関|かか}わり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わからない。
examples.english: He says he has nothing at all to do with that company, but there's no telling if it's true.

notes:
Often written in kana as かかわり; the older spelling {係|かか}わり also appears.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{関|かか}わり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧／⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have something / nothing to do with ~
- {関|かか}わり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to get involved with, to have dealings with
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{関|かか}わり: relationships with people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: relation, relationship (broader, more neutral; also logical or statistical relations)
- つながり: connection, bond (warmer, personal)
